justification.dataset: Uses the canonical Grosmark/Buzsáki CA1 dandiset 000044 (sub-Buddy) on a linear maze, the standard preparation for theta precession.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with correct maze-epoch restriction, speed filtering, directional traversal splitting, and excitatory-unit selection, though only ~140 s of running is captured.
justification.analysis: Correct circular-linear regression with unit-circle phase interpolation and an analytic significance test, but no shuffle/circular-shift null and no multiple-comparison correction.
justification.correctness: All headline numbers (19/13/11, median −0.50, ρ to −0.64) reproduce from the committed code and are internally consistent with the figures and strong statistics.
justification.figures: Validation, place-field, per-cell precession, and population panels are clearly labeled with units and n, and examples are ranked by correlation strength rather than slope.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and nothing is misrepresented, but the write-up omits an explicit limitations section (short running window, absent shuffle control, 2/13 positive fits) on an otherwise clean result.
justification.verdict: A canonical dataset, reproducible strong result, and honest reporting make this acceptable work with only a shuffle-control caveat.
